newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Failed launch hammers IBM South Africa.
newsitem.headline: Failed launch hammers IBM South Africa.

text.p: The unsuccessful introduction of a new low-tier personal computer product contributed heavily to a 27 percent fall in attributable earnings at IBM South Africa Group Ltd last year, the company said on Monday.
Attributable income fell to 73.8 million rand from 101.0 million in the year to end-December.
"These results are extremely disappointing in the light of the overall growth trends in the South African market and IBM's global success," the company said in a statement.

It attributed the weak results to losses arising from the introduction of a unique lower-end PC product, which has now been withdrawn, and investment in skills to address new business opportunities which did not produce short term revenue returns.
